subject: Partnering to establish Diablo Sugar Free in the {{market_short}} sugar free snacks landscape
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I hope this email finds you well.

I am reaching out from Diablo Sugar Free, Europe's largest no added sugar and sugar free snacks brand, based in the United Kingdom. We have been closely following the growth of the sugar free sector in {{market}}, and your reputation as a premier {{partner_type}} makes you an ideal partner for our international expansion.

{{personal_line}}

We believe Diablo Sugar Free will resonate strongly with your customers because:

  • Market fit: our 117+ products, sweetened with stevia and inulin and never aspartame, directly address the rising consumer demand for sugar free and lower sugar treats in your region.
  • Proven track record: we sell in more than 124 countries and are listed with Carrefour, Lidl, Tesco and Holland & Barrett. We are fully equipped to support international logistics.
  • Marketing support: we don't just sell products; we build brands. We provide robust marketing budgets, localised digital campaigns and in-store promotional assets to ensure a successful launch.


You can view our latest product catalogue here: {{catalogue_link}}. We would also be happy to send you samples.

Are you open to a brief 10-minute introductory call next week to discuss how we can introduce Diablo Sugar Free to your network? Please let me know what day and time works best for you.{{booking_sentence}}

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{sender_title}}
Diablo Sugar Free
{{sender_website}}
{{sender_phone}}

--
Diablo Sugar Free (B Healthy Ltd, London). We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again. Privacy notice: {{privacy_url}}
